editor_note: CANDIDATE - verify before activating. On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Friday fry described as shrimp and perch. Neighborhood bar with banquet hall, pool, darts, patio. Listed hours are bar hours - confirm the fry window.

CANDIDATE - verify before activating. OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark). MONTHLY, NOT WEEKLY - the post's own page is titled 'Monthly Fish Fry', calendar shows single Fridays. Currently 'Closed for the summer, Fish Fry will resume this fall' so roughly fall through spring. Deep fried or baked fish and/or shrimp, baked potato or fries, salad bar. The Loyal chamber's 'Every Friday Night' claim conflicts with the post's own site and appears stale. Far outside the footprint.

CANDIDATE - verify before activating. OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark). STRONGEST CONFIRMED HALL FRY ANYWHERE IN THE SWEEP and the only weekly year-round one. Baked or deep-fried cod, shrimp, chicken strips, steak, burgers; fries or potato salad, rye bread, salad bar. Facebook posts in Feb AND Sept confirm not Lent-only. Public dining per the city directory and Clark County Tourism; Tavern League member. Verified active on Google Maps (4.7, 96 reviews). CAVEAT: Neillsville is ~50 minutes southwest of Wausau, well outside the current footprint.
